senses.gloss: [Cunanda, LV 〔1.15〕, false reading for Cunda, q.v.; Tib. skul byed, exhortation-maker, as if from root cud-; so Tib. skul bye = Cunda in Mvy 〔1045〕.]
Cundā, n. of a goddess: Sādh 〔270.8〕 etc. (cf. next).

Cunda-dvīla (v.l. -vīra), nt., or -dvīlā (v.l. -vīrā), f., n. of a locality (adhiṣṭhāna) between Aparagayā and Benares, home of the yakṣa Cunda (2): Mv 〔iii.325.11〕 (nt.); 〔327.18〕 (fem.). Seems to be the same as Pali Cundatthiya, ˚ṭṭhila, ˚tthika, Pv 〔iii.1.2〕 and comm. 〔pp. 168—170〕 (cited DPPN as Cundaṭṭhīla, v.l. Cundavīla, but neither form is recorded in texts or Crit. App.).
Cundā-dhāraṇī, n. of a sacred formula: Śikṣ 〔173.4〕 (cf. preceding).
